snippet.title: Advent/Archive: Reveal Trailer | Shiori Novella RPG Maker fan game
snippet.description:
Advent/Archive is a short fan-game, made in RPG Maker MV, featuring Shiori Novella, and guest starring other talents from Hololive. You play as Shiori, navigating an underground dungeon in search of the Archive. You will have to fight through tough monsters and discover treasure to make it all the way through.

https://damascusvt.itch.io/adventarchive

Disclaimer: Advent/Archive is a free, unofficial fan game. Damascus and Advent/Archive are not affiliated with or represent Hololive or Cover Corp in any way. This project was made while following all guidelines under the Hololive Derivative Works guidelines (https://hololivepro.com/en/terms/).

Advent/Archive features no monetization and is completely free to play. All assets in the game are either made by me or purchased with the license to use commercially and non-commercially.
